When my son died he had 5 drugs in his system which then processed into 7 drugs. When he was found his respiratory system had shut down, foam had blocked his air passages. Since his death 3 others have died from overdoses. My son also had breast cancer pills in his system. Who knows what the dealer told him they were. I miss you my son.
